poc_plan: Goal: validate Dedicated throughput guarantees and latency SLOs for driver chat + embeddings search
Bench harness: Locust + Redwood bench-client wrapper (Redwood to provide client image)
Workloads: representative prompt corpus (2k driver utterances, 1k manifest search queries), mix: 70% chat, 20% embeddings, 10% rerank
Load profile: ramp to target concurrency (200->800 users) over 30 mins, hold plateau for soak
Soak: 72 hours at 60% peak, with intermittent 10x spikes (simulate rush-hour bursts)
Variants: run on H100 reserved pool, A100 reserved pool, and quantized 4-bit variant for cost comparison
Metrics captured: per-request p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec per GPU, GPU utilization, memory pressure, kv cache hit ratio, error rates
Gating: pass if p95 chat latency < 220ms and error rates <0.5% sustained; cost per 1M tokens within quoted band
performance_targets: Chat p95 target: <220ms (turns <128 tokens) under 600 concurrent sessions
Embeddings throughput: >=1200 embeddings/sec per 8xA100 equivalent pool
GPU utilization target: 65-85% steady during soak (avoid sustained 95% which risks throttling)
Availability SLO requested by customer: 99.9% monthly with credit schedule (legal redline)
Fallback policy: automated fallback to smaller model variant with graceful degradation if latency SLO breached
